candidate: Arithmetic mean of VIIRS counts in 64 nearest earlier training dates, ordered deterministically by squared Euclidean distance over log1p MODIS, one-quarter log1p Terra, one-quarter log1p Aqua, and annual sine/cosine; chronological date breaks ties. The fraction of positive training references is a descriptive occurrence probability.
gates_scope: Apply prior daily proposed screening thresholds to the candidate against identity, annual/monthly ratio and hurdle baselines on the same supported test dates and calibration strata; WAPE and interval score no worse. Report hybrids separately. These gates require independent protocol approval for scientific qualification, and this retrospective proposal has no admission path.
inputs: Prediction-time MODIS occupied cell count, Terra/Aqua counts and calendar day; reference VIIRS enters only training values, interval calibration or held-out scoring.
interval: Per-model nominal 90% absolute log1p calibration residual intervals, separate MODIS zero and positive strata. Coverage is empirical under temporal dependence.
limitations: Fixed region and exact cohorts only; no validated observation opportunity, fire truth, synthetic locations or unobserved hourly progression. Estimates remain unavailable as a released product.
occurrence: Report five held-out probability bins and the overall Brier score for observed positive VIIRS activity; empty bins are null. No occurrence-calibration threshold is asserted.
partition: Identical to daily-hybrid-v1.0.0: training before Y-2, calibration Y-2 and Y-1, held-out test Y, with exact complete-export cohort support and quarter/stratum gates.
purpose: Compare a fixed similar-day expected-count model against the existing daily identity, ratio, hurdle and hybrid experiments. Earlier results have been inspected: all available dates are retrospective development evidence, never blind confirmation.
